id: 06_Recognizing Lab Hazards and Selecting the Right PPE A Guide to Lab Safety
title: 识别危害，选对防护
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/06_Recognizing Lab Hazards and Selecting the Right PPE A Guide to Lab Safety.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/06_Recognizing Lab Hazards and Selecting the Right PPE A Guide to Lab Safety/src.py

points.K1: 能伤人的东西，实验室里都可能有
points.K3: 你有权知道接触的是什么
points.K5: 健康、物理、环境三类危害
points.K6: 防护用品要维护好、穿对
points.K9: 危害可预见，就能提前准备
points.S3: 呼吸防护：先通风，再适配

shots.scene: 欣欣穿着实验服、戴着护目镜和手套向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing a lab coat, safety goggles and gloves waves at the camera in a lab.
shots.narration: 这一课讲识别危害、选对防护。

shots.scene: 放大镜、说明书、手套、护目镜四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a magnifying glass, a blank data sheet, a pair of gloves and safety goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 先看清危害，再选对、穿对防护。

shots.scene: 阿杰随手抓起一副薄手套就要去倒试剂
shots.prompt_en: The young male student grabs a pair of thin disposable gloves from a box and heads toward a reagent bottle.
shots.narration: 阿杰随手戴副薄手套，就要去倒试剂。

shots.scene: 阿杰的护目镜推在额头上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student has his safety goggles pushed up on his forehead instead of over his eyes.
shots.narration: 护目镜还推在额头上。

shots.scene: 小研拦下他，递给他一份说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and hands him a blank safety data sheet.
shots.narration: 小研说：先查查它，再挑防护。

shots.section_title: 能伤人的东西，实验室里都可能有
shots.scene: 实验室里浮现很多危险图标：烟雾、雪花、火焰、细菌
shots.prompt_en: Many hazard icons float around a lab: a smoke cloud, a snowflake, a flame and a germ. No people.
shots.narration: 能伤害人和环境的东西，实验室里都有。
overlay: 能伤人的东西，实验室里都可能有

shots.section_title: 能伤人的东西，实验室里都可能有
shots.scene: 温度计两端，一头冰冷一头炽热
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon with an icy blue end and a red-hot end, next to an air particle cloud icon. No people.
shots.narration: 从空气里的有害物，到极冷极热。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起两根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up two fingers with a confident smile.
shots.narration: 今天先抓住几个最重要的点。

shots.section_title: 你有权知道接触的是什么
shots.scene: 阿杰手里的瓶子上浮现一个大问号，问号变成感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A big question mark above a bottle in the young male student's hand turns into an exclamation mark.
shots.narration: 第一，你有权知道自己接触的是什么。
overlay: 你有权知道接触的是什么

shots.scene: 小研翻开空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a blank safety data sheet booklet beside a reagent shelf.
shots.narration: 安全技术说明书，是首要的资料。

shots.scene: 清洁剂瓶和废液桶都配着一份说明书
shots.prompt_en: A cleaning spray bottle and a waste container, each with a blank data sheet beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 清洁剂也好、废液也好，都要查。

shots.section_title: 健康、物理、环境三类危害
shots.scene: 三个图标：心脏、火焰、鱼和树
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a human silhouette with a health hazard star, a flame, and a dead fish with a tree. No people.
shots.narration: 想清楚健康、物理、环境三类危害。
overlay: 健康、物理、环境三类危害

shots.section_title: 防护用品要维护好、穿对
shots.scene: 倒三角最底层亮起，旁边是一副护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The bottom tip of an inverted triangle glows, with a pair of safety goggles beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第二，防护用品虽是最后一道防线，
overlay: 防护用品要维护好、穿对

shots.section_title: 防护用品要维护好、穿对
shots.scene: 小研把护目镜擦干净戴好
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes her safety goggles clean and puts them on properly.
shots.narration: 也要维护好、穿戴正确。

shots.scene: 老周把一箱防护用品放到柜子里
shots.prompt_en: The older man places a box of gloves, goggles and lab coats into a supply cabinet.
shots.narration: 防护用品，由单位和实验室配齐。

shots.scene: 阿杰检查手套，发现一个小洞，举手报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student finds a small hole in a glove, holds it up and calls the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 你要穿对、保持完好，坏了及时说。

shots.scene: 象形图、信号词、标签三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a red diamond pictogram, a bold word box and a blank chemical label. No people.
shots.narration: 标签、象形图、信号词，要读得懂。

shots.scene: 小研给分装瓶重新贴签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sticks a fresh blank label with a red diamond pictogram onto a bottle.
shots.narration: 标签坏了、分装了，要重新贴好。

shots.section_title: 危害可预见，就能提前准备
shots.scene: 欣欣指着一张空白的实验计划
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a blank experiment plan on a clipboard.
shots.narration: 危害取决于你做什么，是能预见的。
overlay: 危害可预见，就能提前准备

shots.section_title: 危害可预见，就能提前准备
shots.scene: 计划表旁浮现对应的防护图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank plan sheet with matching protective equipment icons appearing beside each step. No people.
shots.narration: 能预见，就能提前准备。

shots.scene: 手套和危险物料图标连线
shots.prompt_en: A gloves icon linked by a line to a bottle with a corrosion pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 接触危险物料，选对手套。

shots.scene: 有害气体图标和呼吸防护面罩图标连线
shots.prompt_en: A toxic vapor cloud icon linked by a line to a half-face respirator icon. No people.
shots.narration: 有有害气体，选合适的呼吸防护。

shots.scene: 王老师穿上连体防护服
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator puts on a full-body protective coverall with hood and boots.
shots.narration: 危化品事故处置，穿上全身防护。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现酸瓶和火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of an acid bottle with a corrosion pictogram and a flame pictogram.
shots.narration: 穿好了也要想：身边有哪些危害？

shots.scene: 酸液滴落和火焰两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a droplet of acid falling onto a surface and a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 酸、碱、易燃物，是化学危害。

shots.scene: 生物危害标志、血滴、动物咬痕图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons: a biohazard sign, a blood drop and a small animal bite mark. No people.
shots.narration: 血液、病原体，动物咬伤和虫蜇，

shots.scene: 老鼠和蚊子图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lab mouse and a mosquito with yellow warning triangles. No people.
shots.narration: 都是生物危害，要按规定防护。

shots.scene: 阿杰长时间弯腰看显微镜，揉着后腰
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hunches over a microscope for a long time and then rubs his lower back.
shots.narration: 长时间弯腰、姿势不对，也会受伤。

shots.scene: 小研调整椅子高度，坐直操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student adjusts her chair height and sits upright at the microscope.
shots.narration: 调好桌椅高度，定时起身活动。

shots.scene: 雪花、火焰、锁和挂牌三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a snowflake with a cryogenic dewar, an open flame and a padlock with a blank tag. No people.
shots.narration: 低温液体、明火、检修上锁挂牌，

shots.scene: 电离辐射标志
shots.prompt_en: An ionizing radiation sign on a lab door. No people.
shots.narration: 有的工作还涉及放射性物质。

shots.scene: 三种颜色的手套摆在一起
shots.prompt_en: Three pairs of gloves of different materials and colors laid side by side on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 手套没有万能的，材质要对上物质。

shots.scene: 小研对照说明书的防护部分挑手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks the protection section of a blank data sheet and picks a matching pair of gloves.
shots.narration: 选什么手套，查说明书的防护部分。

shots.scene: 小研往手套里吹气检查有无破损
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student inflates a glove slightly with air to check for holes before wearing it.
shots.narration: 戴前查破损，污染了马上换。

shots.scene: 安全眼镜、护目镜、面屏三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: safety glasses, sealed safety goggles and a full face shield. No people.
shots.narration: 眼睛防护，分安全眼镜、护目镜和面屏。

shots.scene: 有液体飞溅风险时，小研戴护目镜加面屏
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears sealed goggles plus a face shield while pouring liquid inside a fume hood.
shots.narration: 有飞溅风险，戴护目镜，必要时加面屏。

shots.scene: 普通近视眼镜被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A pair of ordinary prescription glasses crossed out with a red X next to goggles that fit over glasses. No people.
shots.narration: 近视眼镜代替不了防护眼镜。

shots.section_title: 呼吸防护：先通风，再适配
shots.scene: 通风柜打勾，口罩打叉
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood with a green check next to a thin paper face mask crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 防有害气体，首选通风柜。
overlay: 呼吸防护：先通风，再适配

shots.section_title: 呼吸防护：先通风，再适配
shots.scene: 王老师帮阿杰检查面罩是否贴合
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator helps the young male student check the fit of a half-face respirator.
shots.narration: 必须用呼吸器时，先培训、做适配。

shots.scene: 小研长发扎起，穿长裤和包脚鞋
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student with hair tied back, wearing a buttoned lab coat, long trousers and closed-toe shoes.
shots.narration: 长发扎起，实验服扣好，不穿短裤拖鞋。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手去碰门把手和手机，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand reaching for a door handle and a phone, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 戴着手套不碰门把、手机。

shots.scene: 阿杰脱下手套扔进垃圾桶后洗手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student peels off gloves inside out, drops them into a bin and washes his hands at a sink.
shots.narration: 离开前脱下防护，认真洗手。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门口，抬手做停一下的手势
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab doorway and raises a paw in a pause gesture.
shots.narration: 总之，动手之前，先停一下想清楚。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现说明书和三类危害图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a blank data sheet and three hazard icons.
shots.narration: 有权知情，查说明书，想全三类危害。

shots.scene: 化学、生物、物理、其他四个危害图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a flask, a biohazard symbol, a bent back and a snowflake. No people.
shots.narration: 化学、生物、物理、其他危害，都要想到。

shots.scene: 手套、护目镜、面罩、实验服四个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons each with a green check: gloves, goggles, a respirator and a lab coat. No people.
shots.narration: 防护选对、穿对、维护好。

shots.scene: 欣欣戴好护目镜，挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot adjusts its safety goggles and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 看清危害，护好自己，下次见！
